svg.title: The resolution story, animated
svg.desc: Vendor-stated resolution of 75 tool models on a log axis from 2000 to 8 nm against their year from 1973 to 2027, appearing in order of introduction with a year counter and a ticker naming each tool that set a new minimum, from 1000 nm in 1980 to 8 nm with High-NA EUV in 2023.
svg.text: VENDOR-STATED RESOLUTION R, BY YEAR OF INTRODUCTION
year of introduction or first shipment
Milestone with no vendor-stated resolution: dashed ring above the axis at its year, not on the R scale
